module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 6

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

@[expose] public section


open SimpleGraph

namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture6
variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 6](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a connected graph `G` we have
`Ls(G) ≥ 1 + n(G) - m(G) - a(G)` where `a(G)` is defined via independent sets.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture6 (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h_conn : G.Connected) :
    1 + (Fintype.card α : ℝ) - matchingNumber G - α(G) ≤ Ls G := by
  sorry

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture6

sources_consulted: E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, November 1996 list with December 1996 proofs, pp. 1–3: https://web.archive.org/web/20230703190700id_/http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII.pdf
review.notes: Checked the sole declaration, WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture6.conjecture6. WOWII item 6 and linked definitions 1, 2, 3, and 5 agree with the Lean inequality and all three invariants. The source marks the result true, credits DeLaVina (1996), and supplies a proof in the original list, agreeing with `research solved`. The Nontrivial assumption implements the necessary small-order convention for degree-one leaves: the singleton has Ls = 0 and right-hand side 1. The source explicitly restricts the Conjecture 1 bound used in its proof of Conjecture 6 to graphs with at least two vertices. Scratch checks in /workspace/review/scratch.lean establish boundedness of the supremum sets, existence of spanning trees under connectedness, empty/singleton values, and (matchingNumber, indepNum, Ls) = (1, 1, 2) for K₂. These checks compile without sorry or reliance on conjecture6. The file under review was not modified.
